title: Ryoji leaves the dorm; Aigis alone with the hero

cues.text: In the dorm lounge, Ryoji turns and walks past the hero toward the door.
The others get up to leave.
Later, only Aigis and the hero remain.
Aigis turns and walks out of the lounge.
She walks down a dorm hallway alone.
Her hand on her chest, she walks on.
